_comment: Icon sizes and the missing-icon placeholder. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror (colors/icon/*); these do not, so they are authored here.

_source.size-*: Figma models icon sizing as the `icons-size` component set (40 components = 10 sizes x 4 colours), not as variables, so there is nothing under {design.semantic.*} to reference. The ten steps are mirrored here as literals. When design.md's `iconography.sizes` stops being 'tbd' these become refs and this note goes away.
_source.missing-foreground: The placeholder shown when a name is not registered. Not a Figma token — Figma has no missing state, because in Figma an icon always exists. secondary.light (#C9C9C9) matches the grey the component already used.

_verified_from.result: The ten size steps match. The glyph set itself is checked continuously by tools/check-icons.py, which fails the build if any name a component uses is missing from icon-data.ts.
